Xiaohongshu Note Booster 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly generate 3 complete, ready-to-publish Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book) notes from a single input.
- Each note includes a viral-style title, structured body copy (150–300 Chinese characters), optimized hashtags, cover-image tips, and recommended publish time.
- Supports diverse templates: recommendation, tutorial, review/comparison, unboxing, vlog script, and more.
- CLI and agent/LLM modes available; accepts minimal or detailed input for flexibility.
- No API keys or external dependencies needed—template-based generation for reliability and speed.
summary: Generate 3 viral-ready Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book) notes from a product, scene, or topic — titles, body copy, hashtags, cover-image tips, and publish-time...
